text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel it! A powerful sense of affinity<n>draws me
toward the fated NHK Mile<n>Championship! I just
know I'm going<n>to crush it today!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This race is the prelude to my world<n>debut. Just sit
back and watch me run<n>fabulously!
